fields.location: North side of Cinder Canyon, 4 miles northeast of Calloway Falls
fields.sizeNote: Mapped at 4:10 PM; up from 1,950 acres at 1:00 PM
fields.activity: Wind-driven runs to the southwest with spotting up to a half mile. Gusts to 35 mph from the northeast until 9 PM; humidity 9 percent.
fields.evacuations: Evacuation orders: Zones C-1, C-2 and C-3. Evacuation warnings: Zones C-4 and C-5.
fields.closures: County Road 12 closed at Mill Bridge; Canyon Road closed above the fire station.
changes: Zone C-3 moved from warning to order at 4:55 PM.
Size increased by 1,250 acres after the 4:10 PM mapping flight.
A third helicopter joined the incident at 3:30 PM.
fields.outlook: Crews will hold the west flank tonight; growth to the southwest is expected until the wind falls after 9 PM.

fields.sizeNote: Estimated from the first engine's size-up at 12:20 PM
fields.evacuations: No evacuation orders or warnings yet. Residents of Zones C-1 and C-2 should be ready to leave.
fields.closures: Canyon Road closed above the fire station.
fields.activity: Moderate uphill spread in grass and brush with 15 mph wind from the northeast.
fields.outlook: Initial attack continues; the fire is expected to grow with the afternoon wind.
